# pocketid_api_client_grant (Resource)

Grants an OIDC client access to one API (`pocketid_api`) in Pocket-ID: which permissions it may request on behalf of a logged-in user, and which it may request as itself with the client credentials grant. The client's grants on other APIs are left untouched. Requires Pocket ID >= 2.14.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pocketid_api" "notes" {
  name     = "Notes"
  resource = "https://notes.example.com"
  permissions = {
    "notes.read"  = { name = "Read notes" }
    "notes.write" = { name = "Write notes" }
  }
}

# A mobile app that signs users in (public client, PKCE) and calls the API on
# their behalf.
resource "pocketid_client" "notes_app" {
  name          = "Notes app"
  is_public     = true
  callback_urls = ["com.example.notes:/oauth2redirect"]
}

resource "pocketid_api_client_grant" "notes_app" {
  api_id                     = pocketid_api.notes.id
  client_id                  = pocketid_client.notes_app.id
  user_delegated_permissions = ["notes.read", "notes.write"]
}

# A backend job that calls the API as itself (client credentials).
resource "pocketid_client" "indexer" {
  name          = "Notes indexer"
  callback_urls = ["https://indexer.example.com/callback"]
}

resource "pocketid_api_client_grant" "indexer" {
  api_id             = pocketid_api.notes.id
  client_id          = pocketid_client.indexer.id
  client_permissions = ["notes.read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_id` (String) The ID of the API (`pocketid_api.id`).
- `client_id` (String) The ID of the OIDC client (`pocketid_client.id`).

### Optional

- `client_permissions` (Set of String) Permission keys the client may request as itself (client credentials grant). Unset: no client access; an empty set: access to the API without any permission. Only confidential clients can use this; for a public client the provider reports an error, as Pocket ID would not grant it.
- `user_delegated_permissions` (Set of String) Permission keys the client may request on behalf of a logged-in user. Unset: no user-delegated access; an empty set: access to the API without any permission.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the grant, `<api_id>/<client_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a grant as <api_id>/<client_id>.
terraform import pocketid_api_client_grant.notes_app 0b6d6f5e-8a3c-4f2e-9b1d-2c7e4a9f1d3b/notes-app
```
